# Favionus
> Turnkey onshore wind LiDAR measurement campaigns. Bankable, quality-controlled wind data for developers, lenders and engineers.

Favionus plans, deploys, monitors and delivers IEC-classified vertical profiling LiDAR campaigns for wind resource assessment, met mast complement, repowering and site investigation. Favionus also offers wind LiDAR rental. It works with LiDAR units from leading manufacturers, matched to the site and hub height.
